name: shoalrun-expanded-v1
label_origin: Expected labels derived by executing frozen source, with model-visible call binding and deterministic replay.
scope: Exact outcomes of five functions on the supplied inputs. The model receives one source module as its rules. This is not full-project validation or a general model leaderboard.
split_policy: Five development and five test mutation families per function, with eight cases per family. Related variants stay together. Shared source rules; no unseen-source or statistically independent-case claim.

oracle_runtime.serialization: JSON; undefined return is {$undefined:true}; undefined object properties omitted; errors retain name and message.
